headline: Get Glynsera
title: How to Get Glynsera | The Strongest Ice Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Glynsera is called the strongest Ice Aniimo in the game. You can fight the Alpha in the Ice Cave of Beast Fang Ridge, south of the Frigid Waters Sanctuary. Or nurture the local Bloom to trigger a Wild Surge, where Bonesky family Aniimo can show up. Alpha Aniimo are hard to catch, so bring a strong Aniipod. Fire or Earth Aniimo make the fight easier. Which way would you try? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Glynsera is an Ice Aniimo found as an Alpha in the Ice Cave of Beast Fang Ridge or through a Wild Surge after nurturing the local Bloom. Fire and Earth Aniimo help in the fight.
